project.name: jev-audit
project.description: Fast probabilistic directory auditing with CLI, MCP, and an optional Runtime bridge.

notes: This first adoption adds the KiNoTch Base and Project Overlay without moving jev-audit Domain files.
Paths declared under paths.source, paths.tests, and paths.docs are Project-owned legacy paths and are editable during adoption; .kinotch and AGENTS.md remain common Base files.
The optional kinotch-runtime dependency remains Project-controlled, is installed from requirements-pilot.txt, and is not enabled by the Base profile.
CLI and MCP implementations remain authoritative Project boundaries.
